emoji-picker-element 1.29.1 and emoji-picker-element-data 1.8.0, Apache-2.0.
Sources: https://github.com/nolanlawson/emoji-picker-element and https://github.com/nolanlawson/emoji-picker-element-data
Library imports use content-hashed local filenames. Chinese data omits search tags, shortcodes and emoticons because search is hidden. Native glyphs are provided by the operating system.
